title: Ordinary closed localization vertex is the integral direct-image Roos vertex
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l. Let i:Z→X be a closed immersion with X noetherian. For a complex K of completed integral coefficient sheaves on X, assume K and its recorded integral pullback i*K are derived complete [def-weil-derived-complete]. The derived ordinary closed composite from [def-sf-recollement-presentation-data] at K is isomorphic to the vertex of a recorded SfIntegralDirectImage i (i*K) [def-weil-derived-direct-image], with countable products supplied by the recorded integral-operations instance. No constructibility, open complement, finite-type over a field, or linearity assertion is made.

source.place: The triangle, integral coefficient case; Constructibility, first paragraph

proof.text: Compare ordinary exact closed restriction of complete K with the completed integral pullback, through the completion unit and normalized finite quotient maps. The closed composite uses exactly the inverse-image map specified in the presentation.

Closed direct image is exact, so its termwise derived functor is its total right derived functor. As a right adjoint the latter preserves countable products and sends the augmented reduction Roos triangle of the complete pullback to a distinguished Roos triangle.

The normalized restriction/direct-image comparisons identify the image terms with sfDirectImageTerm and all arrows with sfDirectImageTransition. Transport the triangle, its projection, and its boundary to construct SfIntegralDirectImage with vertex isomorphic to the ordinary closed composite. Use the completed direct-image reduction proof for these coefficient transports. Zero K and empty Z are included.

proof_origin.place: The triangle, integral coefficient case; Constructibility, first paragraph

from.place: The triangle: identify the ordinary closed term i*i* with the completed integral direct-image value.

lean.statement:
theorem sfIntegralClosedKernel_roos
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsNoetherian X]
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E X))
    (hK : IsSfDerivedComplete l E X K)
    (hiK : IsSfDerivedComplete l E Z ((integralDerivedPullback l E i).obj K)) :
    letI : HasCountableProducts (DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E X)) :=
      integralOperationsDerivedCountableProducts l E X
    ∃ L : SfIntegralDirectImage l E i ((integralDerivedPullback l E i).obj K),
      Nonempty ((sfRecollementModuleClosed l E i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K ≅ L.obj)
